test_title: PYST 1: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 (Shift 3 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown (Figures 1-3). Find the number on the face opposite to the face having ‘1’. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b95c4b7f796e95b986a6a9178f8e62938349e6cf9af5a626d019ebdc51be47a3.png]
solution:
When we compare figure 1 and figure 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74b1e989151c4286a5b7ce52b0777e817b704daa07ec6c511603555718ca6bae.png] We can see that 3 is opposite to 5.

When we compare figure 1 and figure 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3173654209060680dd045a3a6650e85e3437c728cdb9a8beb96cd92355bd956.png] We can see that 2 is opposite to 4.

Now we only have two faces left i.e., 6 and 1 which means 1 and 6 are opposite to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.
